commons.description: A map of eastern Papua New Guinea, with a cutaway of the Okapa region. The area inhabited by the Fore People is highlighted in red.
commons.editorial_reason: Map/graphic showing the Fore region; it does not visibly depict Fore cultural dress, adornment, performance, architecture, craft, or attributed cultural objects.
